description: This is a C source file that contains tests for the libcurl library, including functions for handling transfer status, retrieving and reporting timing information, and executing a curl request with callbacks.

methods.name: int geterr(const char * name,CURLcode val,int lineno)
methods.description: Logs error information related to a CURLcode with associated name and line number.

methods.name: void report_time(const char * key,const char * where,curl_off_t time,bool ok)
methods.description: Reports the timing information for a specific key and location, indicating if the value is okay.

methods.name: void check_time(CURL * easy,int key,const char * name,const char * where)
methods.description: Checks a specific CURLINFO timing value and reports if it's greater than zero.

methods.name: void check_time0(CURL * easy,int key,const char * name,const char * where)
methods.description: Checks a specific CURLINFO timing value to see if it is zero.

methods.name: size_t header_callback(void * ptr,size_t size,size_t nmemb,void * userp)
methods.description: Callback function to handle headers received during transfer, performs timing checks on first header.

methods.name: size_t write_callback(void * ptr,size_t size,size_t nmemb,void * userp)
methods.description: Callback function to handle data received during transfer, writes data to stdout.

methods.name: CURLcode test(char * URL)
methods.description: Executes a curl HTTP request to specified URL, sets options, handles progress and performs cleanup.

ctags.name: check_time
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_time(CURL *easy, int key, const char *name,$/
ctags.signature: (CURL * easy,int key,const char * name,const char * where)

ctags.name: check_time0
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_time0(CURL *easy, int key, const char *name,$/
ctags.signature: (CURL * easy,int key,const char * name,const char * where)

ctags.name: geterr
ctags.pattern: /^static int geterr(const char *name, CURLcode val, int lineno)$/

ctags.name: header_callback
ctags.pattern: /^static size_t header_callback(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb,$/

ctags.name: report_time
ctags.pattern: /^static void report_time(const char *key, const char *where, curl_off_t time,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * key,const char * where,curl_off_t time,bool ok)

ctags.name: write_callback
ctags.pattern: /^static size_t write_callback(void *ptr, size_t size, size_t nmemb, void *userp)$/
